newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 6.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN

- Air safety agency ASECNA, which had agreed to put surplus funds into a new leasing company to take over the planes and debt of multinational carrier Air Afrique, puts plan in doubt by seeking interest on its investment.
- Government aims for annual seed cotton production of 300,000 tonnes within two years.
- President Henri Konan Bedie orders release of students detained after clashes at the universities of Bouake and Abidjan. LA VOIE
- France lends Ivory Coast 13.2 billion CFA for training of farmers and to develop a policy for preservation and sustainable exploitation of forests. LE JOUR
- African Development Bank Group makes loans totalling 85.4 billion CFA to nine countries. (1$=580 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
